children: Sterling is the most preferred currency among the 10 most heavily traded currencies, UBS Global Wealth Management strategists say in their year-ahead 2027 report. The U.K.'s resilient growth, along with the Bank of England's policy rate at 4.0% and another rate increase expected in early 2027, support sterling's performance against lower-yielding currencies, the strategists say. Sterling trades flat versus the dollar at $1.3151 and the euro is flat against sterling at 0.8343 pounds. (miriam.mukuru@wsj.com)
